summary: Iteration 117 - Mandate Evaluation Fix testing complete. ALL 12 tests passed. The evaluate-fit endpoint now correctly produces varied verdicts (weak_match/potential_match/strong_match) with all 3 colors (green/yellow/red) based on actual candidate-job fit.
critical_code_review_comments: AI evaluation is now the PRIMARY evaluator - reads job description/requirements text since most jobs have empty structured fields (key_skills, salary_range, min_experience)
Verdict logic correctly implemented: 3+ reds → weak_match, 0 reds + 3 greens → strong_match
Data completeness check correctly flags missing skills/experience/role/work_history with RED data_quality category
Location evaluation working correctly: same city = GREEN, different city + no relocation = RED
All criteria include text, color, and category fields as expected

success_rate.frontend: N/A - backend only testing per request

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used TEST_ prefixed candidate profiles in request payloads only (not persisted)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 117 fully tested the mandate evaluation fix. Key findings: (1) POST /api/extension/evaluate-fit correctly evaluates candidates against jobs using AI as primary evaluator, (2) Mismatched candidate (Java dev vs Secretary) returns weak_match with 6 red flags, (3) Matching candidate (Secretary vs Secretary) returns strong_match with 5 green criteria, (4) Empty/minimal profile returns weak_match with data_quality red flag, (5) Location evaluation: same city = green, different city + no relocation = red, (6) Verdict logic: 3+ reds gives weak_match, 0 reds + 3 greens gives strong_match, (7) AI generates varied categories (skills, experience, domain, seniority, education, salary, etc.), (8) All 3 colors (green/yellow/red) are properly produced across different scenarios

bug_fixed_verified.original_issue: Mandate evaluation was giving 'good match' to everything - not properly cross-checking parameters and not producing all three categories (green/yellow/red)
bug_fixed_verified.root_cause: Jobs had no structured fields (key_skills, salary_range, min_experience all empty) - only free-text description. Rule-based checks returned empty lists and AI evaluation was too lenient.
bug_fixed_verified.fix_verified: AI is now the primary evaluator that reads description/requirements text, strict prompting requires all 3 colors, data completeness checks added, stricter verdict logic implemented
bug_fixed_verified.test_results: Mismatched candidates now correctly get weak_match with red flags, matching candidates get strong_match with green criteria
